cohort: 9,668 women with PCOS matched to 19,336 controls without PCOS by age, body mass index, and primary care practice in the United Kingdom
finding: Women with PCOS have lower fertility rates before diagnosis but similar rates to controls after diagnosis, and they experience higher rates of pregnancy complications and adverse neonatal outcomes, independent of obesity.
mod_finding: The rate of Caesarean section was higher in women with PCOS compared to controls (27.7% vs. 23.7%).
